strings.name: George W. Bush
strings.role: 43rd US president · War and public policy
strings.summary: Bush served as governor of Texas before becoming US president from 2001 to 2009. The wars in Afghanistan and Iraq after September 11 reshaped international security. His war decisions, detention policies and intelligence claims about Iraqi weapons of mass destruction faced major criticism. He also launched PEPFAR and authorized emergency measures during the financial crisis.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026. Selected milestones do not constitute an exhaustive record of all news or controversies.
strings.influence.rationale: His two presidential terms and decisions on counterterrorism and the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq profoundly affected the international order.
strings.facts.fact-01.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-02.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-02.value: BA in history, Yale (1968); MBA, Harvard (1975)
strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Global HIV/AIDS support
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Proposed PEPFAR in 2003, expanding US support for prevention, treatment and care internationally.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Reshaping international security
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Counterterrorism and the Afghan and Iraq wars had lasting effects; their human costs and justification remain scrutinized.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Announced a new art book
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Announced The Call of Freedom, planned for 2027; it had not been published by the research cutoff.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Left the presidency
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Completed two terms, later pursuing public affairs through the Bush Center and taking up painting.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Signed financial rescue legislation
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Authorized emergency stabilization measures and the Troubled Asset Relief Program during the global crisis.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Launched the Iraq war
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Led the US invasion; the alleged active stockpiles of weapons of mass destruction were not found after the war.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Responded to September 11
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Pursued a global counterterrorism campaign after the attacks and subsequently launched the Afghanistan war.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Inaugurated as president
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Became the 43rd president after the disputed 2000 election and Supreme Court ruling.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Became Texas governor
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Took office after winning the 1994 election and won reelection in 1998.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Completed an MBA
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Graduated from Harvard Business School after Yale and service in the Air National Guard.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Born in Connecticut
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Born in New Haven and grew up mainly in Texas.
